messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up: NebulaHealth (renewal in 6w) asked for an enablement office hour focused on onboarding metrics and anomaly alerts. Can we schedule a 45m session that works for CET/APAC?
Eli Torres: I can run the metrics walkthrough. Prefer 16:30-17:15 CET (which is early APAC). Is that workable?
Jana Park: CET/APAC overlap options: 15:30-16:15 CET (16:30-17:15 UTC?) Wait math: propose 15:00-15:45 UTC or 16:30-17:15 CET (that's 15:30-16:15 UTC). Which is better for Nebula?
Priya Menon: Customer prefers late EMEA  early APAC. Let's pick 15:30-16:15 UTC.
Remi (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: NebulaHealth Onboarding Office Hour  provisional. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/nebulah-onboard. Poll not needed since customer requested time.
Eli Torres: Agenda: 10m intro + 20m metrics walkthrough (dashboards, alert thresholds, anomaly detection tuning) + 15m Q&A and next steps. I'll prepare a short checklist for prework.
Jana Park: Prework to send: 1) list of attendees 2) sample dataset access 3) short survey: "top metric concerns". I'll send invites and recording link.
Priya Menon: For renewal signal capture please use the short feedback form: https://forms.gle/redwood-nebula-feedback  include question on "likelihood to renew" and "main outstanding blockers".
Eli Torres: I'll upload the dashboard screenshots and a 1-page tuning guide by EOD Tue.
Remi (calendar-bot): Event confirmed and invites sent. Recording enabled. Channel created: #nebulah-onboarding-oh.
Jana Park: Thanks team  moving details to the shared folder and the new channel. Closing scheduling thread.
